visual_references.displayed_capture_date: Image capture Nov 2023; photo header Dec 2023
observed_features: Modern TWO-LEVEL cream/off-white rectangular block with flat parapet and repeated deep vertical pilaster bays
Large dark glazed rectangular windows on both levels; narrow horizontal vent/recess bands above and between groups
Small yellow station name plaque high on facade; black rooftop water tanks
Very large independent barrel-vault/arched metal entrance canopy to left, exposed white triangulated steel end truss and thin posts
Broad ascending entrance steps/ramp beneath canopy connect toward blue-roofed covered footbridge/platform route
Forecourt uses red/grey interlocking zigzag paving with earth strips and small planted beds
uncertainties: Exact building room layout not established; do not substitute Nagercoil Junction historic facade
Photo predates2026 final track commissioning; use separate topology evidence
